title: AAPS 3.2.0.4 and NSCLIENTv3 has 10 Entries in queue
symptom: User reports constantly having entries in the queue from the NSCLIENTV3 tab, with 10 entries remaining after synchronization. Data appears to be uploading to Nightscout, and no errors are found.
cause: A commenter suggests that the issue may be caused by deleting an entry from the food database in both Nightscout and AAPS simultaneously, leading AAPS to attempt syncing the deletion with Nightscout, which fails because the record is not found, throwing a Java exception.
evidence_quote: I think something went wrong when we deleted an entry from the food database (maybe in NS and at the same time in AAPS). AAPS tries synching the deletion with NS, doesn't find a record with that identifier and throws a java exception
